name: smile-fx-plugins
description: Sixteen plugins for practice and business owners: small business operations, marketing, sales, customer support, finance, HR, legal, data and more. Adapted from Anthropic's open-source knowledge-work-plugins under the Apache License 2.0.

plugins.name: sfx-small-business
plugins.description: Runs the business side of a practice or small business: cash, bills, payroll prep, sales follow-up, marketing, reviews and hiring. Ask in plain words and it picks the right workflow. It asks before anything sends, posts or pays.

plugins.name: sfx-marketing
plugins.description: Plans campaigns, drafts content, checks brand voice, audits SEO and reports on results across your marketing channels.

plugins.name: sfx-sales
plugins.description: Preps calls, summarizes meetings, drafts follow-ups, researches accounts and reviews your pipeline, using your CRM, email, calendar and call notes, or uploaded files. It updates records or sends email only when you ask.

plugins.name: sfx-customer-support
plugins.description: Triages questions, drafts replies, packages escalations and turns resolved questions into help articles.

plugins.name: sfx-operations
plugins.description: Documents processes, reviews vendors, plans capacity, tracks compliance tasks and writes status reports.

plugins.name: sfx-finance
plugins.description: Prepares journal entries, reconciliations, financial statements and variance analysis, and supports month-end close and audit prep.

plugins.name: sfx-human-resources
plugins.description: Supports recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation analysis and policy questions.

plugins.name: sfx-productivity
plugins.description: Keeps a task list and a working memory of your people, projects and shorthand, and pulls new tasks from your calendar, email and chat.

plugins.name: sfx-legal
plugins.description: Reviews contracts against your playbook, triages NDAs, checks compliance questions and drafts briefings for your counsel. It does not give legal advice.

plugins.name: sfx-data
plugins.description: Writes SQL, explores data sets, runs statistics, builds charts and dashboards, and checks an analysis before you share it.

plugins.name: sfx-design
plugins.description: Critiques designs, writes interface copy, reviews accessibility, synthesizes research and prepares developer handoff notes.

plugins.name: sfx-enterprise-search
plugins.description: Searches your email, chat, documents and wikis in one request, and writes digests of what changed.

plugins.name: sfx-product-management
plugins.description: Writes specs, plans roadmaps and sprints, synthesizes research, reviews metrics and drafts stakeholder updates.

plugins.name: sfx-pdf-viewer
plugins.description: Opens PDFs in an interactive viewer so you can read, annotate, fill forms and place signatures, then download the marked-up copy.

plugins.name: sfx-engineering
plugins.description: Supports standups, code review, debugging, architecture decisions, incident response and technical documentation.

plugins.name: sfx-plugin-builder
plugins.description: Builds new plugins from scratch and customizes existing ones for your own tools, terms and workflows.
